correctness.rationale: For a bidegree-(2,2) form over F_3, writing it as A(U,V)S^2+B(U,V)ST+C(U,V)T^2 gives discriminant B^2-AC because 4=1 in characteristic three. A smooth connected (2,2) divisor is a genus-one double cover of P^1; squarefreeness of the binary quartic discriminant is equivalent to smoothness, with the endpoint-root multiplicities checked separately. The independent Jacobian-ideal check examines all four standard affine charts; Euler identities in bidegree two ensure vanishing of all homogeneous partials forces F=0. The projective coefficient space has 9841 nonzero forms up to scale; the Groebner check identifies 5184 smooth forms. Pair enumeration yields 3,594,672 bases, divisible by six, hence 599,112 pencils; the independent RREF subspace enumeration reports the same 599,112. Base-point counts are 0,1,2,3 with 115,848, 306,432, 153,792, 23,040 pencils respectively. Hasse gives b<=4; b=4 would force all four genus-one members to have seven rational points, but the complete joint-count output has no (7,7,7,7) tuple and the independent RREF distribution has no b=4. Source code and outputs were inspected, not treated as an infinite-proof substitute.
